note: Illustrative ranges compiled from 2026 third-party data (AIR Media-Tech, vidIQ, creator reports). Platform rates change constantly — verify live before making decisions. These are ranges, not promises.

facebook_content_monetization.rpm_note: Wide range; Reels often $0.02–$0.20. Retired programs merged into CMP Aug 31, 2025

tiktok_creator_rewards.rpm_note: Some finance/tech creators report up to $1.50–$2.00; UK/non-US often $0.03–$0.25

youtube_ypp_tier2_full.note_2027: Reported: new-applicant thresholds rise to 8,000 watch hours or 20M Shorts views from Feb 1, 2027 (vidIQ, single source — verify live)

sponsorship_rule_of_thumb.note: Common starting point: $20–$50 per 1,000 expected views for a dedicated integration in mid-value niches; finance/tech 2–3x, entertainment lower. Negotiate on audience quality, not just views. Verify with current creator rate reports.
